SELECT a.AccountCode, a.AccountName, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.DebitAmount, 0)), 2) AS total_credit FROM AccountingPosting p JOIN LedgerAccount a ON p.LedgerAccountId = a.LedgerAccountId JOIN SalesDocument d ON p.SalesDocumentId = d.SalesDocumentId WHERE IFNULL(d.IsCanceled, 0) = 0 AND d.DocumentDate >= '2026-03-01' AND d.DocumentDate < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY a.LedgerAccountId, a.AccountCode, a.AccountName ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(p.DebitAmount, 0)) DESC, a.AccountCode ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT a.AccountCode, a.AccountName, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.CreditAmount, 0)), 2) AS total_credit FROM AccountingPosting p JOIN LedgerAccount a ON p.LedgerAccountId = a.LedgerAccountId WHERE p.PostingDate >= '2026-03-01' AND p.PostingDate < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY a.LedgerAccountId, a.AccountCode, a.AccountName ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(p.CreditAmount, 0)) DESC, a.AccountCode ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT a.AccountCode, a.AccountName, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.CreditAmount, 0)), 2) AS total_credit FROM AccountingPosting p JOIN LedgerAccount a ON p.LedgerAccountId = a.LedgerAccountId JOIN SalesDocument d ON p.SalesDocumentId = d.SalesDocumentId WHERE IFNULL(d.IsCanceled, 0) = 0 AND d.DocumentDate >= '2026-03-01' AND d.DocumentDate < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY a.LedgerAccountId, a.AccountCode, a.AccountName ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(p.CreditAmount, 0)) ASC, a.AccountCode ASC LIMIT 10
